title: Scythe: Semantic-Aware Rewriting for Fast,Effective Program Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2611.06515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated program reduction shrinks a program into a smaller one that preserves a property of interest. Language-agnostic grammar-based reducers are easy to retarget across languages, but because they reason only about syntax, they cannot perform the coupled edits needed to remove whole declarations, e.g., a method cannot be deleted while it is still called. As a result, they waste oracle calls on edits that cannot succeed and often leave irrelevant declarations behind. We present SCYTHE, a fast, semantic-aware pre-processing step that runs in front of any grammar-based reducer without modifying it. SCYTHE encodes the program as a typed declaration dependency graph and applies a set of semantic-aware operators that decouple declarations from their use sites, making them removable while keeping the program well-typed. Fine-grained token-level minimization is then left to the downstream reducer. On 73 benchmarks across C, Java, and Solidit

translated_title: Scythe：用于快速、高效程序约简的语义感知重写
translated_abstract: 自动化程序约简（program reduction）将程序缩减为一个更小的、且保留感兴趣属性的程序。与语言无关的基于文法的约简器易于跨语言移植使用，但由于它们仅进行语法层面的推理，无法执行删除完整声明所需的耦合编辑——例如，一个方法在被调用时无法被直接删除。因此，这类约简器会在注定无法成功的编辑上浪费预言机调用，并且经常留下不相关的声明。我们提出了 SCYTHE，这是一种快速、语义感知的预处理步骤，可以运行在任何基于文法的约简器之前，且无需修改后者。SCYTHE 将程序编码为一个带类型的声明依赖图，并应用一组语义感知的算子，将声明与其使用位置解耦，使这些声明在保持程序类型正确的前提下变得可删除。随后，细粒度的词法级最小化工作则交由下游的约简器完成。在涵盖 C、Java 和 Solidity 的 73 个基准测试上（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SCYTHE 是一种语义感知的预处理步骤，通过将程序编码为带类型的声明依赖图并解耦声明与其使用位置，使任何基于文法的程序约简器都能更快速、更有效地删除完整的声明。
en_tdlr: SCYTHE is a fast, semantic-aware pre-processing step that encodes programs as typed declaration dependency graphs and decouples declarations from their use sites, enabling any grammar-based reducer to remove whole declarations faster and more effectively.
